body.p: Please amend the claims as is shown in the following listing of claims, which listing replaces all prior listing of claims in the application. In the listing of claims, claims 5-20 are shown as withdrawn in view of the election made herein.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A method for implementing a cloud-based portable miniaturized system for performing a non-invasive blood glucose level measurement in real time, the method comprising:
translating raw optical measurement ("IT") to calibrated optical transmission measurements ("A") based on operating conditions ("Io") of an optical transmission source of the system;
preprocessing the calibrated optical transmission measurements;
providing the preprocessed calibrated optical transmission measurements to at least one chemometric model to obtain an estimate of a concentration of acetone in [[the]]a breath of a subj ect;
mapping internal transmittance at a first wavelength and matching the mapped internal transmittance to a lookup table entry; and
reporting an average of the matched lookup table entry and the estimate from the at least one chemometric model as a concentration of the acetone in the breath.
2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising preprocessing the calibrated optical transmission measurements prior to providing the preprocessed calibrated optical transmission measurements to the at least one chemometric model.
3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the translation translating the raw optical measurement to the calibrated optical transmission measurements is performed in accordance with A = -log 10(IT/Io).
4. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the first wavelength aligns with an absorption wavelength of a particular concentration of acetone.
5. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) A method for implementing acloud-based portable miniaturized system for performing non-invasive blood glucose level measurements in real over time, the method comprising:
using an optical source to emit optical radiations at certain wavelengths through breath in an air collection chamber;
receiving the emitted optical transmissions radiations at a photodetector;
converting the received optical transmissions radiations to digital data;
accumulating the digital data for a first time period; and
periodically transmitting the accumulated digital data to a cloud service for further processing.
6. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 5, wherein the optical source comprises at least one of a Quantum Cascade Laser ("QCL"), miniaturized near infrared ("NIR") spectrometer, and an LED.
7. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 further comprising adjusting an optical path length between the optical source and the photodetector by adjusting a number of reflections experienced by the emitted optical radiations.
8. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 5, wherein each one of the certain wavelengths aligns with an absorption wavelength of a particular concentration of acetone.
9. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) An apparatus for implementing acloud-based portable miniaturized system for performing non-invasive measurement of blood glucose level measurement in real time, the apparatus comprising:
a system housing for collecting breath of a [[user]]subject,the system housing comprising:a spectrometer printed circuit board ('PCB') connected to [[the]]an inlet diaphragm; and
a reflective surface opposite the spectrometer PCB;
wherein an air containment section is disposed between the spectrometer PCB and the reflective surface; and
an optical source disposed on a surface of the spectrometer PCB;
wherein radiation emitted from the optical source travels through breath disposed within the air containment section, is reflected by the reflective surface, and is detected by [[the]]an optical detector.
10. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 9, wherein the system housing further comprises a mouthpiece for receiving breath expelled by the [[user]] subject.
11. (Withdrawn) The apparatus of claim 10, wherein the system housing further comprises a particulate filter for filtering particulates from the received breath.
12. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 11further comprisinganthe inlet diaphragm being connected to the particulate filter.
13. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 12 further comprising an outlet diaphragm connected to the air containment [[tube]] section.
14. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 9 further comprising a reflective coating disposed on an inside of each of the air containment section to adjust an optical path of the radiation through the breath disposed within the air containment section.
15. (Withdrawn) The apparatus of claim 9, wherein the optical source comprises at least one of a Quantum Cascade Laser ("QCL"), a miniaturized near infrared ("NIR") spectrometer, and an LED.
16. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 9 further comprising a sensor for measuring device configured to measure a temperature of the breath disposed within the breath collections section.
17. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 9 further comprising electronics for converting configured to convert the detected radiation into digital data and calculating a raw spectral power density of the detected radiation.
18. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 17 further comprising a gateway device for transmitting configured to transmit the digital data and the raw spectral power density to a cloud service for processing.
19. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 9,wherein the optical source emits optical radiations at certain wavelengths through breath in the air containment section collection chamber.
20. (Withdrawn) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein each one of the certain wavelengths aligns with an absorption wavelength of a particular concentration of acetone.
